messages:
zoe: Heads up team — publishing two related items today: a docs localization rollout (ES/FR/DE) and a planned deprecation of the legacy sync client in the SDK. Full PRs and timelines linked below.

marcus: timeline?

zoe: TL;DR: docs localized pages go live on staging now and will be promoted to prod on 2026-05-05 after review. Legacy sync client (redwood.sync.Client) is deprecated today and will be removed in ~120 days (2026-09-01). We will ship compat shims for 60 days and security fixes only after deprecation.

hana: Breaking changes we should call out in localized docs?

zoe: Yes — two important migration notes that need to be in all locales:
1) Sync -> Async client: `redwood.sync.Client` -> `redwood.client.RedwoodClient` (async-first). We added migration snippets in each language.
2) Default output format changes: `generate(..., raw=True)` is now `generate(..., format='raw')` to support richer structured outputs in future. Both are backward-compatible via compatibility flags for the deprecation window.

product-bot: i18n PR published: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/526 (ES/FR/DE). Please review translations and regional examples.

marcus: How are we handling support for localized screenshots and examples? I know some quickstarts show region-specific Console UI.

zoe: We created locale-specific examples and screenshots. Each locale folder has an examples/ subfolder. Doc builders will fallback to en-US assets if a localized screenshot is missing, but CI will warn. We also added a checklist for legal/localization review for EU-specific compliance wording.

hana: For deprecation, what should support flag in search/KB look like?

zoe: Suggested KB blurb (short): "Legacy sync client deprecated. Upgrade to async RedwoodClient by 2026-09-01. Compatibility layer available until 2026-07-01. See migration guide: /sdk/migrate-sync-to-async." Put that at the top of relevant locale pages.

marcus: Any env var or config changes tied to this release?

zoe: No env var changes. We did add a per-locale doc config file (docs/config.locale.toml) that defines date formats and examples. Nothing customer-facing.

product-bot: migration guide published: /sdk/migrate-sync-to-async https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/528

hana: Please add a short snippet that shows how to enable the compatibility shim in case customers need more time.

zoe: Added this snippet to the migration guide: 
```
# enable compatibility shim (temporary)
from redwood import compat
compat.enable_sync_fallback()
```
Note: shim logs a deprecation warning on first import.

i18n-bot: localization checklist: translators assigned (es: carla, fr: pierre, de: utkarsh). Review due by 2026-04-30.

marcus: Let's coordinate a support playbook: top 3 errors we expect are import errors, asyncio runtime errors, and format mismatch on generate() calls. @hana can you draft canned replies with example tracebacks?

hana: On it. I'll include locale-specific examples for common traceback messages where translations could confuse users.

zoe: Communication plan: 1) internal announce in #docs and #eng tomorrow; 2) customer-facing note in docs changelog in each locale; 3) email to high-usage accounts flagged by Product; 4) migration webinar week after launch.

marcus: Analytics—can docs team add a dashboard to track search queries for "sync client", "async", "migration" over next 90 days? We should monitor uptrends to prioritize support.

zoe: Yes, added an analytics tile to Console docs dashboard and scheduled weekly alerts if search rate > 3x baseline.

product-bot: release: docs localization + sync-client deprecation posted to staging. Merge window target: 2026-05-04 09:00 UTC.

zoe: Action items: @hana draft support KB + canned replies; @marcus confirm customer list for targeted email; i18n team to finish translations by 2026-04-30; docs to monitor analytics and support queue. Thanks! :globe_with_meridians:
